inventoryVerification.scope: Frozen verifier full inventory/parts/hierarchy/fragments plus its historical selected QA fixtures. Historical QA endpoint coverage is not current business coverage.

packageIdentity.authority: Exact converted content fingerprint plus five resource path/bytes/SHA pins; portable package UUID equality is diagnostic only.

identity.mappingOnlyCandidatePolicy: Decoded separately, treeReachable=false; excluded from ordinary tree candidate counts, matches retained for review. No omission-cause or geometry/visibility inference.

properties.scope: Reachable tree names plus direct and SDK-style inherited eligible property aliases; exact display-name shadowing and inherited-hidden filtering. Not a live SDK replay.

summary.candidateCountScope: Reachable tree metadata candidates only; mapping-only candidates are separately retained and require review.

existingRequestedCaptureLimits.scope: All copied cable endpoints only: Routes counts a case-sensitive raw trimmed Set and checks lengths before capture NFC dedup. Excludes standalone drafts, selected-cable narrowing, route-rule and geometry gates; not a product capture PASS.

summary.categorySource: Exact raw cable.mto only; Instrumentation uses Control. Unknown/null requires resolution; typeName is never a category source.

gaps: Metadata candidates are not confirmed shared bindings, equipment roles, bottom-centre points, native visibility, category eligibility or engineering acceptance.
The retained computational capture is still52objects/26routing leaves; this audit creates no new geometry, graph, location, proposal or job.
Business source snapshot is immutable copied input, not a claim that the source database stayed current after its recorded transaction.

semanticSource.note: Offsets describe inspected pinned source. No native source parity or live SDK replay claimed.
